# 24. The report cache never exceeds 50 MB

Date: 2026-10-21

## Status

Proposed (drafted by an agent; the coordinator confirms)

## Context

The kiosk has 1 GB of RAM. Loading a report is slow (see 0022). Two speed-ups were considered: an in-memory LRU of recently opened reports, and an index on the existing SQLite cache (0008).

## Decision

**Words:** 「FYI the kiosk has only 1 GB of RAM. The report cache must never grow past 50 MB.」 — Mira Example, 2026-10-21

**Options considered:**
- add an index to the SQLite cache (chosen): fits 0008, which says report data is never cached only in process memory
- in-memory LRU — rejected: conflicts with 0008 and adds memory pressure on a 1 GB kiosk

**Recommended:** the chosen option.

The report cache must never grow past 50 MB. Any cache layer, on disk or in memory, must enforce this limit. The kiosk has 1 GB of RAM.

## Consequences

Later work follows this rule until a newer record supersedes it. It is a size limit only; it does not change the 24-hour expiry (0007).
EOF
